summary: Linear offers self-service OAuth app registration through its developer settings. No approval process is required; developers can create credentials immediately after filling out a short form.
requirements: A Linear account (personal or workspace admin)
One or more HTTPS redirect URIs (localhost allowed for development)

steps.text: Sign in to Linear and open Settings → API → OAuth applications
Fill in the application name, redirect URI(s), and optional description/logo
Submit the form to receive your Client ID and Client Secret
Store the Client Secret securely — it is shown only once

blockers: Redirect URIs must use HTTPS (except http://localhost for local development)
Client Secret is displayed only once at creation; if lost, a new secret must be generated
Scopes are requested at authorization time, not configured during app registration
